one_line: Early medieval Meitei ruler of Kangleipak, remembered for codifying duties and offices in the Loiyumba Shinyen.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to mid-30s, lean yet athletic build with the presence of a disciplined warrior-king.
appearance.face: Oval face, warm medium-brown complexion, sharp nose, high cheekbones, slightly arched brows and large serious anime eyes; a calm, thoughtful default expression with a hint of stern resolve and a small vertical tilak-like mark on the forehead.
appearance.hair: Thick straight black hair gathered into a high, neat topknot at the crown, with the sides smoothly pulled back; a narrow white cloth headband encircles the base of the topknot, and a small simple gold disc ornament sits at the front center of the band.
appearance.costume: He wears a wrapped off-white cotton dhoti (phanek-style lower cloth) tied just above the waist and reaching to the ankles with a neat front pleat, paired with a fitted long-sleeved pale cream cotton upper garment that closes with a diagonal overlap from right shoulder to left hip; over this he drapes a soft, finely woven shawl of muted red (khudei-like) across the left shoulder and under the right arm so it bands his chest diagonally, its border carrying a thin dark green stripe and a slightly thicker yellow stripe; at his waist sits a simple brown leather belt with a small bronze buckle securing a cloth sash knot on his left side, and he wears narrow gold bangles on both wrists, small round gold stud earrings, and plain dark brown leather sandals; textiles are mostly plain-weave cotton with subtle handloom texture, no heavy embroidery, keeping the look practical and courtly rather than ostentatious.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a red cotton cord and housed in a slim dark-brown wooden case, held in his left hand or tucked under his arm, symbolizing the Loiyumba Shinyen charter and codified duties.

ref_desc: King Loiyumba is a medium-brown skinned, sharp-featured man in his early 30s with a black topknot and white headband, wearing an off-white dhoti, cream long-sleeved tunic, muted red bordered shawl, simple gold jewellery and sandals, carrying a dark-brown cased palm-leaf manuscript tied with red cord.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of King Loiyumba: a lean, medium-brown skinned Meitei ruler in his early 30s with an oval face, sharp nose, high cheekbones, large serious eyes and a calm, thoughtful expression with a small vertical mark on his forehead; his thick black hair is pulled into a neat high topknot bound by a narrow white headband with a small gold disc ornament at the front. Dress him in an off-white cotton dhoti wrapped to the ankles with a clean front pleat, a fitted pale cream long-sleeved upper garment overlapping diagonally from right shoulder to left hip, and a soft muted red shawl draped from his left shoulder under his right arm, its edges marked by a thin dark green stripe and a thicker yellow stripe. Add a simple brown leather belt and cloth sash knot at his left hip, narrow gold bangles on both wrists, small round gold stud earrings, and plain dark brown leather sandals; the fabrics should feel like plain-weave handloom cotton, practical yet courtly, without ornate embroidery. In his left hand or tucked under his arm, show his signature item: a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundled in a slim dark-brown wooden case, tied with a red cotton cord, symbolizing his charter. Present him front, side and three-quarter views in the same outfit and colours, emphasizing consistent face, hair, costume and the palm-leaf manuscript case as his defining prop.
